response.what_it_is: A car headlamp assembly wrapped in plastic film
hidden_risks: Broken or cracked mounting tabs on the rear
Cloudiness or yellowing hidden beneath the plastic wrap
Damaged internal reflectors or bulb sockets
Cracks in the housing causing moisture leaks
response.best_proof: A clear photo of the back of the headlamp showing the condition of the mounting tabs and connectors
seller_claims_unsupported: Exact model year compatibility from front view alone
response.failure_mode: AI might misinterpret the watermark text as the brand name or misjudge the lens condition because of the plastic wrapping.
